scientific_integrity: All-width spectral claims are proved by exact prefix-sign and Fourier arguments; asymptotics use standard explicitly identified invariance/Feynman--Kac results. Independent validation is not represented.
scientific_limitations: Exact singular-width finite nullities, quantitative limiting rate and higher-row spectra are not determined. An earlier equivalent signed Ferrers-ideal character formula cannot be excluded.
title: Fourier invertibility transition and Brownian spectral law for two-row order ideals
